storage.built_in: Hot-swappable Surveillance Class HDD, factory RAID 5. 8 TB: 4x2 TB, 6 TB after RAID 5. 16 TB: 4x4 TB, 12 TB after RAID 5. 32 TB: 4x8 TB, 24 TB after RAID 5

power.supply: Max 650 W, 305 W PoE dedicated; 100–240 V AC, 50–60 Hz

features: Integrated PoE switch: 16x PoE RJ45 1 Gbps, 1x AUX RJ45 2.5 Gbps, 1x LAN RJ45 2.5 Gbps, 1x LAN SFP 1 Gbps
Video compression: H.264, H.265 (depending on camera support)
Supports all camera resolutions and frame rates
Compatible with AXIS Camera Station Edge, AXIS Camera Station Pro and partner video management software
Axis Edge Vault, TPM 2.0 (CC EAL4+, FIPS 140-2 Level 2)
notes: Datasheet gives power consumption, excluding connected devices, by variant: typical 31 W (8 TB), 34 W (16 TB), 44 W (32 TB); maximum 37 W, 41 W, 49 W. consumption_w is the 8 TB typical value.
weight_g is for the 8 TB variant; datasheet gives 10.24 kg (8 TB), 10.08 kg (16 TB) and 10.68 kg (32 TB).
